description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractTwigCallable` within the Twig templating engine. It provides base functionality for callable objects, including managing options, names, and deprecation handling for Twig callables.

classes.name: AbstractTwigCallable
classes.description: An abstract class that represents a callable entity within Twig, managing its options, name, and deprecation info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the callable with name, optional callable, and options, handling deprecation info.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the callable, including class name and callable name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the callable.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Retrieves the dynamic name of the callable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the underlying callable object or function.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the node class associated with this callable.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates if the callable needs charset information.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates if the callable needs environment context.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates if the callable needs the context.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a clone of this callable with new dynamic arguments and names.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method to set arguments; use withDynamicArguments() instead.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable is variadic.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is deprecated.

methods.name: triggerDeprecation
methods.description: Triggers a deprecation warning if the callable is deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves the package responsible for deprecation.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves the version in which the callable was deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves the alternative suggested for deprecated callables.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates the minimum number of arguments required to invoke the callable.
